Chrome / Edge 116+：打开扩展管理页，开启开发者模式，选择“加载: Chrome / Edge 116+: First copy the extension folder to a permanent location so app updates do not change its path. Open the extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose “Load unpacked”, and select that copy. Click the extension icon on each page you want to adjust and enable tab control. Each tab has its own volume, which is also affected by this app’s master volume. Safari does not support per-tab control. App identification depends on the audio processes reported by macOS.
USB 音量未运行或状态服务未响应。: USB Volume is not running or its status service is not responding.
USB 音量未运行，无法读取状态。: USB Volume is not running. Status is unavailable.
USB 音量需要读取系统播放的声音，在本机调节音量后发送给 USB 音箱。不会录: USB Volume needs access to system audio to adjust its volume locally and send it to your USB speakers. Audio is never recorded, saved, or uploaded.
eqMac 正在接管系统输出。请先退出 eqMac，再开启 USB 音量。: eqMac is controlling system output. Quit eqMac before starting USB Volume.
启用音量控制后，播放音乐或视频以显示应用。: Enable volume control, then play music or a video to see apps here.
应用静音暂时失效，已静音总音量。请重试后手动取消总静音。: App mute is temporarily unavailable, so master volume has been muted. Retry, then manually unmute master volume.
当前音箱的音频格式暂不支持。请将音箱设为双声道 48 kHz 后重试。: This speaker format is not supported. Set the speakers to stereo, 48 kHz, and try again.
待系统允许，尚未生效: Pending system approval; not active yet
总音量与应用音量叠加生效。网页标签页可通过浏览器扩展单独调节。: Master and app volume apply together. Use the browser extension to adjust individual tabs.
所有应用随总音量调整: Master volume applies to all apps
播放音乐或视频后，应用会显示在这里。: Play music or a video to see apps here.
断开后停止控制，连接时询问是否启用。: Stop control when disconnected; ask to enable when connected.
无法创建键盘音量控制。请确认辅助功能权限后重新打开应用；键盘控制当前未启用。: Keyboard volume control could not start. Check Accessibility permission and reopen the app. Keyboard control is currently off.
无法创建键盘音量控制，请重新打开应用。: Keyboard volume control could not start. Reopen the app.
无法创建音量处理器。: The volume processor could not be created.
无法创建音频处理通道。: The audio processing route could not be created.
无法启动音频。请允许「USB 音量」的系统音频录制权限后重新打开应用。: Audio could not start. Allow system audio recording for USB Volume, then reopen the app.
无法将提示音切换到音箱。: Alert sounds could not be routed to the speakers.
无法将输出切换到音箱。: Output could not be switched to the speakers.
无法建立音频回放。: Audio playback could not be set up.
无法识别本应用的音频进程，请重新打开应用。: The app's audio process could not be identified. Reopen the app.
无法读取系统音频。请在系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 屏幕与系统音频录制中允许「: System audio is unavailable. Allow USB Volume in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, then try again.
无法读取音箱采样率。: The speaker sample rate could not be read.
无法输出 USB 音量状态。: USB Volume status could not be printed.
无法连接音箱的音频处理通道。: The speaker audio processing route could not be connected.
未找到音箱。请接好 USB 后刷新设备列表。: Speakers not found. Connect the USB cable and refresh the device list.
系统尚未允许登录时启动。: The system has not yet approved launch at login.
系统未能更新登录启动设置。: The system could not update the login setting.
系统输出已改变，控制已停止。请关闭 eqMac 等音频处理软件后重新启用。: System output changed and control stopped. Quit other audio processing apps such as eqMac, then reconnect.
请在系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能中允许「USB 音量」控制键盘音量键: Allow USB Volume in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility to use keyboard volume keys.
键盘音量控制尚未就绪，请重新打开应用。: Keyboard volume control is not ready. Reopen the app.
音箱将恢复原始音量，请先暂停播放。: The speakers will return to their original volume. Pause playback first.
音箱已断开。重新连接后，点击启用。: The speakers were disconnected. Plug them in and reconnect.
音箱的音频格式已改变，请重新启用。: The speaker audio format changed. Reconnect to continue.
音频通道未就绪，或音频格式不受支持。请关闭其他音频处理软件后重试。: The audio route is not ready or its format is unsupported. Quit other audio processing apps and try again.
